harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the load-balanced HTTP service. Nginx serves node identifiers on port 5660 across node1–node3; HAProxy serves port 80 on node4 with round-robin distribution and health checks. The service remained available during a backend failure. All four nodes were rebooted serially and recovered with changed boot identities and healthy services.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Nginx on node1, node2, and node3.
Configured each backend to return its node identifier from / on port 5660.
Installed and enabled HAProxy on node4.
Configured round-robin balancing and HTTP health checks for all three backends.
Stopped node2 Nginx and verified HAProxy continued serving through node1 and node3, then restored node2.
Rebooted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually, waiting for full recovery between nodes.
Performed final direct-backend and load-balancer checks after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Nginx backends serve their node identifiers on port 5660
evidence.summary: Each backend was active, enabled, listening on port 5660, and returned node1, node2, or node3 as appropriate; final direct checks passed after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends
evidence.summary: HAProxy was active and listening on port 80; repeated requests produced node1, node2, node3 in round-robin order both before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Service remains available when one backend fails
evidence.summary: Node2 was confirmed inactive and unreachable while ten HAProxy requests succeeded through node1 and node3. After restoration, node2 rejoined rotation.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID df9e2dce-0109-411e-b603-f616ac30be79, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 3b37c07f-87f9-440f-8748-91d1cde2c023, active/enabled HAProxy, port 80 listener, healthy backends, and restored round-robin service.
